mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_view_log (user_id, target_type, target_id, ip, user_agent, view_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, now())

choose.when: select count(*) from voya_ai_city where id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from voya_ai_attraction where id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'
choose.otherwise: select count(*) from voya_ai_guide where id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'

mapper.update: update voya_ai_city set view_count = greatest(0, ifnull(view_count, 0) + #{delta}) where id = #{targetId}
update voya_ai_attraction set view_count = greatest(0, ifnull(view_count, 0) + #{delta}) where id = #{targetId}
update voya_ai_guide set view_count = greatest(0, ifnull(view_count, 0) + #{delta}) where id = #{targetId}
mapper.select: select v.id, v.target_type, v.target_id, v.view_time, case v.target_type when 'city' then c.name when 'attraction' then a.name when 'guide' then g.title else null end as target_title, case v.target_type when 'city' then c.cover_image when 'attraction' then a.cover_image when 'guide' then g.cover_image else null end as target_cover_image from voya_ai_view_log v left join voya_ai_city c on v.target_type = 'city' and v.target_id = c.id and c.del_flag = '0' left join voya_ai_attraction a on v.target_type = 'attraction' and v.target_id = a.id and a.del_flag = '0' left join voya_ai_guide g on v.target_type = 'guide' and v.target_id = g.id and g.del_flag = '0' where v.user_id = #{userId} order by v.view_time desc, v.id desc limit 100

select v.id, v.user_id, v.target_type, v.target_id, v.view_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, case v.target_type when 'city' then c.name when 'attraction' then a.name when 'guide' then g.title else null end as target_title, case v.target_type when 'city' then c.cover_image when 'attraction' then a.cover_image when 'guide' then g.cover_image else null end as target_cover_image from voya_ai_view_log v left join voya_ai_user u on v.user_id = u.id left join voya_ai_city c on v.target_type = 'city' and v.target_id = c.id left join voya_ai_attraction a on v.target_type = 'attraction' and v.target_id = a.id left join voya_ai_guide g on v.target_type = 'guide' and v.target_id = g.id where v.id = #{id}
